title: Antidote Optimization
description: An Optimization modpack that bring vulkan to minecraft, for the best performance
body:
⚡ Antidote Optimization – Vulkan Optimization Pack (1.21.11)

🚀 Maximum performance. Minimal compromises. Powered by Vulkan.

This modpack is fully focused on performance optimization for Minecraft Java 1.21.11, built on Fabric and Vulkan-based rendering to deliver much higher FPS, smoother gameplay, and improved stability — even on low-end or CPU-limited systems.

The goal is simple:
More FPS, fewer stutters, vanilla-friendly experience.

✨ Key Features

🔥 Significant FPS boost using Vulkan rendering

🧠 CPU & memory optimizations

💾 Faster loading times

🧩 High compatibility with other mods & modpacks

🌿 No gameplay changes – pure optimization

🛠️ What’s Inside

Carefully selected performance-focused mods

Rendering, chunk loading, lighting, and simulation optimizations

Lightweight and actively maintained mods only

Perfect for:

💻 Low-end PCs & laptops

🧱 Heavy modded setups

⚔️ Hardcore / Survival / PvP

🎮 Players who want performance without OptiFine

⚙️ Technical Info

🧩 Mod Loader: Fabric

🎮 Minecraft Version: 1.21.11

🖥️ Rendering API: Vulkan

⚠️ IMPORTANT – READ BEFORE PLAYING

❌ You MUST remove the mod ImmediatelyFast.
ImmediatelyFast is NOT compatible with Vulkan and will cause crashes or severe rendering issues if left installed.

➡️ Launching the game with ImmediatelyFast enabled will break the modpack.

✅ Recommended If You:

Want maximum FPS with Vulkan

Experience stutters or frame drops

Need a clean optimization base

Prefer modern rendering pipelines
